component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Explore scientific dynamical models through local AI chat

description.p: Ask the Model is a local AI chat interface designed to query, explore and discuss repositories of scientific dynamical models such as Empirical World3 Dynamics, Cognitive Belief Dynamics and Romanian Monetary Dynamics through natural language while keeping user data on-device. The scientific models remain canonical in their own repositories and are not embedded in the application.
Installation and release-distribution correction with a directly downloadable Flatpak release asset and clarified dependency guidance.
Local Chat Baseline with local Ollama discovery, completion-capable AI-model selection, refresh progress, streamed chat and in-session history.
